analysis.title: Deleveraging Alert: Quiet Ahead of Election Results, but US & EU Indicators Remain "On"
key_insights: The US Equity L/S Indicator has been on for a fourth consecutive session and the Quant Indicator for a second. Both flag hedge fund de-grossing.
US Quants cut more than 3 standard deviations of gross exposure yesterday. Equity L/S cut a more moderate 0.5 standard deviations because substantial de-grossing had already happened.
The Fundamental L/S deleveraging in Hyperscalers and Semis appears to have spread into Quant strategies and then to Europe and Japan.
The Europe Equity L/S Indicator is on for a second consecutive session. Fundamental Equity L/S cut 0.5 standard deviations of European gross yesterday.
US Equity L/S flows were muted ahead of the election results. The largest move was +1.2 standard deviations of net buying in Ex-AI names, split 50/50 between long buying and short covering.
European flows were also subdued. The largest move was -1.2 standard deviations of net selling in EU Banks, driven 75/25 by shorting versus long selling.
Defensive Healthcare and Pharma in Europe continued to see buying of more than 1 standard deviation.
Hedge funds continue to cut long exposure to European Energy and add shorts, a theme in place since mid-October.
Japan was closed on 2 November for Culture Day, so no Japan flow data is reported for that session.
